title: Survey on the Use of Digital Media in Hospitals and Medical Practices from the Perspective of Patients with Gynecological Conditions (Expression XIX / NOGGO S32)
summary:
Telemedicine is a location-independent and time-flexible online service for medical care. This includes, for example, video consultations, during which patients and doctors can see each other via a webcam. It is also possible to communicate at a later time via text or voice messages using a platform or app. Such services can also be used to book appointments, send images, and document and monitor medical readings, amongst other things.
This study aims to collect data reflecting the current use of and knowledge regarding digital media among gynaecology patients in their daily lives and, in particular, in healthcare (telemedicine). The survey serves to conduct a needs analysis.
A questionnaire will be used to determine how many patients use telemedicine, what they perceive to be the state of telemedicine provision in German hospitals and practices, and what the advantages and disadvantages of telemedicine are in the day-to-day management of their condition. The aim is to identify any concerns, reservations and barriers regarding the use of telemedicine services, so that these can be addressed specifically in future and the potential of telemedicine can be better utilised in the interests of patient-centred care.
Furthermore, the study aims to investigate whether the non-use of telemedicine services is primarily due to fundamental doubts about this form of care or to uncertainties and feelings of being overwhelmed when dealing with the technical aspects. The latter could be positively influenced through training or further education in telemedicine. 
Based on the findings, it should be possible to address patients’ concerns more effectively, thereby facilitating future communication between doctors and patients and improving the care patients receive in their day-to-day lives with their condition.

interventions.name: Patients with gynaecological cancer are surveyed once using a questionnaire developed specifically for this purpose
Patients with a gynaecological condition (excluding cancer) are surveyed once using the same questionnaire developed specifically for this purpose

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Women in Germany who are currently being treated, or have been treated, in a hospital or practice for gynaecological conditions.
- Completion of the questionnaire.
Exclusion criteria:
Under 18 years of age
